name: css-blast-radius
description: See how many pages of your site a CSS edit reaches, as you type, backed by a local blast-radius daemon.

commands.title: Show Pages This File's Edits Reach

cssBlastRadius.siteRoot.description: Folder with the site's built HTML (relative to the workspace). Overrides cbr.config.json; empty: the config file or the workspace root.

cssBlastRadius.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the deployed site, for the live check (L3) and capture of a served site. Overrides cbr.config.json.

cssBlastRadius.dataDir.description: Where the index is stored. Empty: .css-blast-radius/ in the workspace.

cssBlastRadius.diffBase.description: What your edits are compared with when the daemon starts. Empty: HEAD (uncommitted changes). Change it at runtime with “CSS Blast Radius: Change Diff Base”.

cssBlastRadius.warnLostPages.description: Warn in Problems when removing a rule or changing a selector stops it from reaching at least this many pages.

cssBlastRadius.codeLens.description: Show page counts above each rule.

cssBlastRadius.nodePath.description: Node.js (≥ 20) used to run the daemon. Empty: “node” on PATH. The editor's own runtime isn't used because the index database is a native module.

cssBlastRadius.daemonPath.description: Path to the backend CLI (cli.js). Empty: the backend next to this extension.
